name: Investment 2 Choice
definition: Specifies the financial instrument purchased by a central counterparty using clearing member assets.

UnsecuredCashDeposit.name: Unsecured Cash Deposit
UnsecuredCashDeposit.definition: Indicates that the investment was made in an unsecured deposit at a commercial deposit taking institution.

CentralBankDeposit.name: Central Bank Deposit
CentralBankDeposit.definition: Indicates that the bank deposit is placed at a central bank.

RepurchaseAgreement.name: Repurchase Agreement
RepurchaseAgreement.definition: Indicates that the investment was made in a repurchase agreement.

OtherInvestments.name: Other Investments
OtherInvestments.definition: Indicates that the investment is not covered by other available investment options.

OutrightInvestment.name: Outright Investment
OutrightInvestment.definition: Indicates that the investment was an outright purchase of a financial instrument or security as an investment.
